# OxytoZen Lab

UK supplier of oxytocin research reagents.

## Products
- Oxytocin 5 mg lyophilised research vial
- Oxytocin research solution 5 mL — currently sold out
- Wholesale research-vial enquiries from 10 units

## Intended use
Products are for laboratory research only and are not supplied for human or veterinary administration.
